scenes.description: Dark storm clouds gather above distant hills, viewed from a sheltered window, with broad rumble-like arcs below the cloud bank.
A relaxed cat curls beside a seated person while its neck is stroked, eyes closed and chin slightly raised.
A large rounded stone rolls down an empty earthen slope, leaving a disturbed contact trail and small dust marks.
A smiling person lounges sideways on a sofa with an arm behind their head and no task underway.
Separate rounded stones of various sizes lie scattered over open ground, without rolling trails.
A person beside a sandy path narrows one eye, holding a hand near the cheek and a clean tissue in the other hand.
